A band of minotaurs hides objects stolen from the dwarves in their tower west of Kazordoon. Enter through the secret hideout, climb the {wiki:Minotaur Tower|Minotaur Tower} fighting Minotaur Guards, Archers and Mages, and collect a {item:Steel Helmet}, two piles of coins and the scroll {item:The Fox Is Out (Book)|The Fox Is Out}.
The hideout of a band of minotaurs holds objects stolen from Kazordoon.
Loose Stone Pile behind the Plum Tree
Take the chance to do the {wiki:To Outfox a Fox Quest|To Outfox a Fox Quest} at the same time: it takes place in the same spot.
{creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} and {creature:Minotaur Archer|Archers} attack from a distance: pull them back behind the walls and fight one at a time.
{creature:The Horned Fox}, a rare spawn, may show up.

The hideout is on the surface, **west** of {wiki:Kazordoon}. Kazordoon has no regular boat: go on foot (for example from Thais through the {wiki:Mount Sternum} pass) or take the {wiki:Steamship} in Cormaya or Farmine ({key:kazordoon}) and leave the mountain through the main entrance. Travel **west** of Kazordoon, past the {wiki:Dwarf Mines|Dwarf Mines}. Hidden behind a {item:Plum Tree} there is a {item:Loose Stone Pile}: use the {item:Shovel} on it and go down the hole.
Loose Stone Pile behind the Plum Tree
Entrance: the Loose Stone Pile behind the Plum Tree
On the way you may run into {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Bear|Bears}, {creature:Bug|Bugs} and {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}.
Going up to the Secret Hideout
Down there, walk **west** and go up with the {item:Rope} to the {wiki:Secret Hideout|Secret Hideout}.
Path to the hideout: yellow = start, green = rope spot
Climb the tower floor by floor and clear each one:
2 Minotaur Guards in each room (north and south)
North: 2 Minotaur Guards, 4 Minotaur Archers. South: 2 {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, 4 Minotaur Archers
North: 4 Minotaur Archers. South: 1 Minotaur Mage, 3 Minotaur Archers
The rewards are scattered around the hideout.
Open the {item:Chest of Drawers (Quest)|Chest of Drawers} next to a table.
Chest of Drawers next to the table (56 gold)
Go up one more floor and open the {item:Box (Quest)|box} next to an anvil.
Box next to the anvil (Steel Helmet)
Box next to the anvil (Steel Helmet)
On the same floor, open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} between a bed and a table: it has the scroll of {creature:The Horned Fox}.
Chest between the bed and the table (scroll)
Chest between the bed and the table (Horned Fox's scroll)

Go back the same way: go down the tower floor by floor to the ground floor of the hideout, go down the rope spot hole you came up through, walk **east** to the {item:Loose Stone Pile} hole and use the {item:Rope} to return to the surface, next to the {item:Plum Tree}.
Exit: hole behind the Plum Tree
